prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1248; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were involved in on a street in Pasadena, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just say I'm the driver of the blue sedan. Is that okay?

Q: For the record, we will use a placeholder. Please state your relationship to the vehicle involved.

A: I was driving it. It's my car.

Q: Can you describe what happened leading up to the impact?

A: I was stopped at a red light, waiting to turn. I had my foot on the brake. Then I felt a hard jolt from behind, like the car was shoved forward.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did you notice the other vehicle before the impact?

A: No, not really. I looked in the mirror a second before, but then it hit me. I didn't have time to react.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: I got out, but I was holding my neck and my lower back. It was stiff and sore right away.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They said I had neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff when I turn my head, and my lower back aches when I sit too long. Sleeping has been hard.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I've missed a few shifts. I'm still working, but I have to take breaks.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car fixed and my back to feel normal again.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
